name: Tag
use: use for a recorded condition on a list row (pig list, pig profile): its name, day count and care level, never colour alone.
notUse: not for a workflow state like Active or Done — use Status; not for a filter choice — use TaskChips.

name: Detail
use: use at the head of a condition's record page: the care-level word, the day count and any note.
notUse: not in a list row — use the tag; not to edit the care level — use a Choice field.

name: Mark
use: use as the icon slot of a Row that lists conditions needing attention: the care icon tile alone.
notUse: not on its own where the care word is not printed beside it — use the tag.

name: Compact
use: use inside an animal Row when an animal can carry several conditions and one line must show them: the name only, with the level in its look (act: red wash with the "!" icon; watch: outlined; ongoing: plain muted).
notUse: not where the day or the care word must be read — use the tag; not as a button.
